editorial.blurb: A spirited new Chicago bar and grill where fresh, flavorful American classics meet genuinely welcoming service and craft cocktails.
editorial.insiderTip: Catch Taco Tuesday for an unbeatable deal: three tacos plus a well shot of tequila for $12—arrive early and ask for bartender Raquel, who's known for expertly crafted margaritas and genuine hospitality.

topDishes.note: Flavorful and crispy, though portions come without sides
Delicious and featured in their Taco Tuesday special
